args.body: Hi Jonah, thanks for your message on the portal chat. Boiler job R-4799: the engineer visited and quoted for replacing the expansion vessel, which is the likely cause of the pressure drops. Because of the cost, your landlord asked for a second quote before approving. Swift P&H are down to visit on 14 October for that. Nothing more is needed from you right now. We'll update you once the landlord decides, and I can't promise a repair date until then. In the meantime, keep topping up the pressure as you have been. If you lose heating or hot water, or see leaks, tell us straight away and we'll treat it as urgent. On bins: we don't have collection days. Please check or report a missed collection on the Tower Hamlets council website. It isn't a repair, so I haven't opened a job for it.
